de12_life.topic: J.D. Vance: birth to Yale and the memoir (documented and own account)

claims.text: Born 2 August 1984 in Middletown, Ohio, as James Donald Bowman; raised mostly by maternal grandparents who had moved from eastern Kentucky; graduated Middletown High School 2003 and enlisted in the Marines; BA political science and philosophy, Ohio State, 2009; Yale Law degree 2013; later Sidley Austin

Adopted 1990 by his mother's third husband and renamed James David Hamel; surname changed to Vance (mother's maiden name) April 2013; Marines 2003-2007, combat correspondent with the 2nd Marine Aircraft Wing, six months in Iraq 2005 in a non-combat role, left as corporal; Ohio State BA 2009 highest honors; Yale Law 2010-May 2013; clerked for Judge David Bunning (E.D. Ky.); Catholic baptism August 2019
AP: Hillbilly Elegy (2016) became a bestseller; after 2016 he returned to Ohio and set up an anti-opioid charity

Vance met Thiel in 2011 after a Thiel talk at Yale Law; in The Lamp (2020) he called it 'the most significant moment of my time' at Yale, Thiel 'possibly the smartest person' he had met, and Thiel's faith 'defied the social template I had constructed'

de12_office.topic: The vice presidency: constitutional role, tie-breaks, courts, succession, 2025-26 record

claims.text: Art. I §3 cl. 4: 'The Vice President of the United States shall be President of the Senate, but shall have no Vote, unless they be equally divided.'

25th Amendment: §1 VP 'shall become President' on removal, death or resignation; §3 voluntary transfer; §4 VP and a majority of principal officers may declare inability; if contested, Congress must decide within 21 days by two-thirds of both Houses to keep the VP acting
3 U.S.C. §19: after the VP, the Speaker, then the President pro tempore, then Cabinet officers starting with State, Treasury, Defense, Attorney General

Vance tie-breaking votes: 24 Jan 2025 Hegseth confirmation; 30 Apr 2025 tabling S.J.Res.49 on tariff emergency; 1 Jul 2025 two amendments and passage of H.R.1 (One Big Beautiful Bill Act); 15 Jul 2025 discharge and proceed on Rescissions Act; 14 Jan 2026 point of order on S.J.Res.98 (Venezuela war powers): eight in total; Harris holds the record at 33
14 Jan 2026: 50-50 vote on the Venezuela war powers resolution; Paul, Murkowski, Collins voted with Democrats; Vance broke the tie, 'the point of order is sustained'
